aggregation: max of native roughness (RMS residual from a plane, 5 m window); NoData as for slope; values above 327.67 m saturate at 327.67
layout: row-major from the north-west corner of each tile
subsamples_per_cell: 5x5 points per app cell, each mapped to its nearest native 1 m pixel
source: MRO HiRISE DEM 1 m, set 1228 (esp_062530_1985_esp_062319_1985_tied-dem.tif), Day et al. 2023
